title: Paragraphs -- Example 2 (Young Children and Learners)

illustrates.quote: Guiding principles: Paragraphs must be easily identifiable and easily found with the fingers (when tracking the left-hand margin of a page). Producers may employ additional features to enable identification of paragraphs for young children and those learning braille.

blocks.features: Prose statement of an alternative paragraph format for young/learning readers: a blank line before each paragraph, in addition to cell-3/cell-1 margins. No print passage or braille rendering is given.

braille.notes: No worked print or braille excerpt is given for this item; it is a one-sentence prose statement of the alternative convention.

resolution: Both runs agree: prose-only, no braille. status: no-braille.
